WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank or missing)') AS hand,
           COUNT(*) AS tally
    FROM player_award AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank or missing)')
), shares AS (
    SELECT hand,
           tally,
           1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT hand,
       tally,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess_over_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
ORDER BY hand
